# Introduction

Write prose in markdown. Use **bold**, *italics*, [links](https://rmarkdown.rstudio.com/), and lists:

* first point
* second point

The data contain `r nrow(dat)` observations.

# Model

We estimate the model:

$$
mpg = \beta_0 + \beta_1 \cdot weight + \epsilon
$$

```{r model}
m <- lm( mpg ~ wt, data = dat )
pander( m )
```

```{r plot, fig.cap="Fuel efficiency declines with vehicle weight."}
plot( dat$wt, dat$mpg, pch = 19, col = "gray40",
      xlab = "Weight (1000 lbs)", ylab = "Miles per gallon", bty = "n" )
abline( m, col = "firebrick", lwd = 2 )
```
